description: Expected signals for QD6 Phase 3 test fixtures — wf-fix-probe-static-data.sh (3 bash checks vs 6 probe specs). Only CHECK 1 (entity guard) is live_detectable at standard profile. CHECK 2 (EF Config FK) requires deep+. CHECK 3 (AlterColumn) requires exhaustive. All 6 probe specs are documented_gap (IMPL-REFUTED in Phase 2).

signals.match_pattern: CHECK 1: public static OrderEntity Create( — no Result.Failure / Guard. / throw
signals.note: CHECK 1: find -path '*/Domain/Entities/*.cs' → OrderEntity has Create() with no guard → emit 'Entity Create thieu validation guard'

signals.match_pattern: CHECK 1: public static ProductEntity Create( — no guards
signals.note: CHECK 1: ProductEntity has Create() with no validation guard → emit signal. Second entity, same check.

signals.match_pattern: CHECK 1: public static CustomerEntity Create( — no guards
signals.note: CHECK 1: CustomerEntity has Create() with no null check → emit signal. Third entity, same check.

CHECK 2 (deep+ only): EF Config has Property(*Id) but no HasOne/WithMany → emit 'EF Configuration thieu FK relationship'. NOT live_detectable at standard profile — marked documented_gap because profile-gated AND EF Core specific only (not in probe specs).

CHECK 3 (exhaustive only): grep -rEn 'AlterColumn.*maxLength: [0-9]+' finds pos-04 migration → emit 'Migration AlterColumn co the gay data loss'. NOT live_detectable at standard — marked documented_gap because exhaustive only AND no EXCLUDE filter applied (bash oversight: Migrations/ not filtered for grep). AlterColumn + maxLength must be on SAME line for single-line grep to match.
TN-001: InvoiceEntity has Create() WITH Result.Failure<InvoiceEntity>() → grep finds 'Result.Failure' → CHECK 1 guard passes → no signal
TN-002: SubscriptionEntity has Create() WITH throw new ArgumentException → grep finds 'throw new ArgumentException' → CHECK 1 guard passes → no signal
TN-003: CustomerEntityConfiguration has Property(x => x.TenantId) (matches Property.*Id) BUT also has HasOne<TenantEntity>() → CHECK 2 guard passes → no signal. Tests the negative path of CHECK 2.
TN-004: BaseEntity is abstract with NO Create() method → CHECK 1 first condition fails (grep for 'public static .* Create(' not found) → no signal

TN-005: OrderService is in Services/ path — not matched by find -path '*/Domain/Entities/*.cs' (CHECK 1) or -path '*/Configurations/*.cs' (CHECK 2). No AlterColumn pattern for CHECK 3. All 3 checks produce 0 signals.

SPEC-GAP: P-QD6-schema-drift-detect — NOT implemented in wf-fix-probe-static-data.sh. Bash does 3 EF Core checks only (no ORM schema vs migration comparison). --probe flag is cosmetic (line 38: no case dispatch). IMPL-REFUTED in Phase 2.

SPEC-GAP: P-QD6-migration-integrity — NOT implemented. Probe spec: reversibility down(), destructive migration detection, CDG-DELETE-DATA escalation. Bash implements none of these. CHECK 3 partially overlaps (AlterColumn detection) but is EF Core specific and profile-gated. IMPL-REFUTED in Phase 2.

SPEC-GAP: P-QD6-constraint-violation — NOT implemented. Spec is runtime (DB query), bash is static EF Core only. DISCREPANCY-1 (type: runtime vs static). DISCREPANCY-2 (cache: skip vs allowed). IMPL-REFUTED in Phase 2.
SPEC-GAP: P-QD6-data-type-mismatch — NOT implemented. Spec: ORM property type vs DB column type comparison. Bash has no type cross-comparison logic. IMPL-REFUTED in Phase 2.
SPEC-GAP: P-QD6-orm-model-sync — NOT implemented. Spec: ORM model ↔ DB schema synchronization. Bash has no DB introspection. IMPL-REFUTED in Phase 2.
SPEC-GAP: P-QD6-seed-data-audit — NOT implemented. Spec: seed data unique constraint, FK reference validation. Bash has no seed file parsing. IMPL-REFUTED in Phase 2.
